record.summary: Passive.ALIEN_DNA has no combat effect and no PassiveEffects entry. Its only reader is the METEORITE item effect: when the player drops METEORITE on a unit whose passive is ALIEN_DNA, the unit is transformed (player.transformPokemon) to the next form in the cycle DEOXYS -> DEOXYS_ATTACK -> DEOXYS_DEFENSE -> DEOXYS_SPEED -> DEOXYS, and the item is not equipped (the effect returns false, which cancels the drag-drop). Each form's own skill, stats, range and maxPP come from its class (the four forms differ: skills PSYCHO_BOOST / ZAP_CANNON / PROTECT / EXTREME_SPEED). Acquiring a Deoxys form gives the player a METEORITE if they hold none; selling a form removes it.
triggers: Dragging METEORITE onto a unit with passive ALIEN_DNA (OnItemDroppedEffect)
Player acquiring a Deoxys form (onAcquired: add meteorite if absent), including via transformPokemon
Selling a Deoxys form (afterSell: remove meteorite)
